prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a ready-to-go companion or build your custom pet.", "Companion Archetypes"]
1: ["Save Your Companion to Your Account", "Sign in now to sync your new pet safely across all your desktop devices."]
2: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Try these quick actions to learn how your pet lives on your desktop screen.", "Desktop Controls Tutorial", "Launch Pet on Desktop"]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay", "Your pet walks right on top of your desktop windows. Make sure application permissions are granted.", "Ready to Launch"]
4: ["Use your primary account to automatically restore existing pets and save current progress."]
5: ["Upload Photos for Custom Pet", "Use clear, well-lit photos facing forward for the best rendering result.", "Tips for perfect 3D pet generation"]
6: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Choose a preset pet profile or craft a custom friend."]
7: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet...", "We are generating high-res desktop animations. You can minimize this window anytime."]
8: ["Welcome Starter Pack Unlocked!", "Finish onboarding to claim your pet's starter desktop accessory.", "Unlocked: Golden Collar Item"]
9: ["Your New Virtual Companion Awaits", "Bring an interactive pet to your desktop in under 2 minutes.", "Adopt Now"]
